title: Razorpay Agent Studio - WooCommerce Connector MCP Tool Specification
description: Standard Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool schema definitions for the WooCommerce Private Connector.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List orders from the merchant store with pagination and filtering by status, customer ID, or date range. Enables Agent Studio agents to inspect recent merchant order volume and statuses.

per_page.description: Number of orders to retrieve per page (max: 100, default: 10)

after.description: ISO 8601 date string to fetch orders created after (e.g. '2026-03-01T00:00:00Z')

before.description: ISO 8601 date string to fetch orders created before (e.g. '2026-03-31T23:59:59Z')

customer.description: Filter orders by specific numeric customer ID

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Fetch comprehensive details for a specific WooCommerce order by its numeric ID. Returns line items, billing/shipping addresses, payment method, transaction IDs, totals, and customer notes.

order_id.description: The unique numeric ID of the order (e.g. 1042)

tools.name: search_orders
tools.description: Search merchant orders by customer email, customer name, order number, line item products, or payment transaction IDs (e.g. Razorpay payment ID).

query.description: Search keyword (email, name, order ID, product name, or payment ID)

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: reconcile_payment
tools.description: Cross-verify a Razorpay payment ID and expected order amount against the WooCommerce order record. Essential for payment dispute resolution, chargeback checks, and order fulfillment verification in Razorpay Agent Studio.

expected_amount.description: Expected order total amount in store currency to check for discrepancies

tools.name: get_connector_metrics
tools.description: Retrieve real-time connector operational telemetry, including total requests, throttled requests (HTTP 429), successful retry backoffs, and token bucket state.
